اعتمرنا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَرْنَا (iʕtamarnā) /iʕ.ta.mar.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# اُعْتُمِرْنَا (uʕtumirnā) /uʕ.tu.mir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
